name: On
title: Rebel Against Moses
summary: On, son of Pelet, was a Reubenite who joined Korah's rebellion against the leadership of Moses and Aaron in the wilderness. He is mentioned only briefly in Numbers 16:1, and his further fate is not explicitly described in the text. Some Jewish traditions claim that his wife persuaded him to withdraw from the rebellion.

keyEvents.title: Participation in Korah's Rebellion
keyEvents.description: On, son of Pelet, is mentioned as one of the four main figures who rose up against the authority of Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: The Rebellion Against Moses' Leadership
keyEvents.description: The rebels accused Moses and Aaron of exalting themselves above the Lord's congregation, claiming that the entire people were holy.

keyEvents.title: Korah's Punishment
keyEvents.description: God punished the rebels by opening the earth and swallowing Korah, Dathan, and Abiram along with their families and possessions. On is not explicitly mentioned in the description of the punishment.

keyEvents.title: Warning for future generations
keyEvents.description: The rebellion against Moses and Aaron became a lasting warning to the people of Israel about the consequences of rebelling against God's chosen leaders.
